blockchain.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
blockchain.excerpt: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

blockchain.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
blockchain.excerpt: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

blockchain.title: Hackers Jailbreak iPhone 18 Pro on Stage, and It Survives a Reboot
blockchain.excerpt: Calif showed an untethered jailbreak on an iPhone 18 Pro running iOS 27.0.1 at Hexacon in Paris. It survived a reboot, but no tool or bug details are public yet.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin Bounces, But Where Does It Go Next? Here’s What the Charts Say
blockchain.excerpt: Technical indicators suggest the bullish trend remains intact, but prediction market traders are sending mix signals.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin price steadies around $82K after Fed’s Warsh avoids rate-hike hints
blockchain.excerpt: Bitcoin held above $80,000 as South Korean tech stocks recovered from a sell-off and traders lowered their expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike.

defi.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
defi.excerpt: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

defi.title: Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
defi.excerpt: Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.

defi.title: Circle Plans Push Into 40 Emerging Markets as Stablecoins Go Mainstream, CEO Says
defi.excerpt: Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire told Reuters the USDC issuer plans to enter about 40 emerging and developing markets, citing rising demand in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East.

defi.title: Bitcoin Treasury Giant Strategy Faces Index Removal Under Finalized MSCI Rules
defi.excerpt: The index provider will classify “non-operating companies” as ineligible starting Nov. 30, targeting firms whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset.
